title: Naomi Watts Reunites with Tom Holland in Spider-Man: Brand New Day
description: Actress Naomi Watts has made a voice cameo in the animated series 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day,' reuniting her with actor Tom Holland nearly 14 years after their first collaboration.

sections.heading: Background
paragraphs: Naomi Watts, known for her roles in various films and television series, has recently made a voice cameo appearance in the animated series 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day.' This marks a reunion with actor Tom Holland, who has portrayed Spider-Man in recent live-action films.

sections.heading: Reunion Details
paragraphs: According to Just Jared, Naomi Watts and Tom Holland first worked together nearly 14 years ago. The recent collaboration in 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' has brought them back together, showcasing their continued professional relationship in the entertainment industry.

sections.heading: Character and Role
paragraphs: SlashFilm reports that Naomi Watts voices the character E.V., who is Peter Parker's AI assistant in the series. This role connects her directly with Tom Holland's character, Spider-Man, in the storyline.
